name: Madeira
description_en: Run x86-64 Windows PC games on jailed iOS via FEX-Emu + Wine + DXMT
readme_excerpt: Madeira Run Windows PC games on a non-jailbroken iPhone. Madeira combines Wine (ARM64EC), FEX-Emu for x86-64 → ARM64 translation, and DXMT for D3D11 → Metal, running as a single Mach process on iOS with wineserver as a thread rather than a separate process. Status Thumper and ULTRAKILL are playable. Marvel Cosmic Invasion has reached gameplay, though a run has also ended in an unexplained termination and its controls are not yet reliable.
